mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a simple shot, but nonetheless can be devastating against an attacking opponent."
Block The block is a simple shot, but nonetheless can be devastating against an attacking opponent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the end point of the shot."
The finish is the end point of the shot.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a scheme of how we plan to approach the play."
Strategy is a scheme of how we plan to approach the play.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as the forehand drive."
Everything else is the same as the forehand drive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first movement after you've seen the ball."
The backswing is the first movement after you've seen the ball.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same as that used for the backhand drive."
The stance is the same as that used for the backhand drive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a trademark name for table tennis and associated equipment."
Ping-Pong is a trademark name for table tennis and associated equipment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the defensive, backspin counterpart to the offensive loop drive."
Chop A chop is the defensive, backspin counterpart to the offensive loop drive.
fib: ______ is used mostly for keeping the ball in play, applying pressure on the opponent, and potentially opening up an opportunity for a more powerful attack.
drive
drive is used mostly for keeping the ball in play, applying pressure on the opponent, and potentially opening up an opportunity for a more powerful attack.
______ is the forward movement, towards the ball.
strike
The strike is the forward movement, towards the ball.
______ are the 5,000metres and 10,000-metre races, held on a track, and the marathon, contested on roads.
Olympic events
Olympic events are the 5,000metres and 10,000-metre races, held on a track, and the marathon, contested on roads.
______ is a softer shot and therefore requires more feel and less weight transfer/power.
push
The push is a softer shot and therefore requires more feel and less weight transfer/power.
______ is the controller of the conduct of the game.
umpire
The umpire is the controller of the conduct of the game.
______ is responsible for the appointment of match officials.
referee
The referee is responsible for the appointment of match officials.
______ is responsible for the enforcement of the rules and interpretations in the case of conflicts or judgment calls.
Head Referee
Head Referee is responsible for the enforcement of the rules and interpretations in the case of conflicts or judgment calls.
______ is any running event on the track that is longer than 3000metres.
long distance race
A long distance race is any running event on the track that is longer than 3000metres.
